title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of determination and perseverance
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting that resolute and steadfast individuals never give up until they achieve their cherished goal. He emphasised that just as the deities remained undeterred by the precious gems and deadly poison encountered while churning the ocean, they did not cease their efforts until they obtained the nectar of immortality. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “रत्नैर्महाब्धेस्तुतुषुर्न देवा न भेजिरे भीमविषेण भीतिम्। सुधां विना न प्रययुर्विरामं न निश्चितार्थाद्विरमन्ति धीराः॥” The Subhashitam conveys that just as the deities, undeterred by the precious gems found in the ocean and undismayed by its deadly poison, did not cease their efforts until they obtained the nectar of immortality, so too do resolute and steadfast souls never rest until they attain their cherished goal. In a post on X, Shri Modi said; “रत्नैर्महाब्धेस्तुतुषुर्न देवा न भेजिरे भीमविषेण भीतिम्। सुधां विना न प्रययुर्विरामं न निश्चितार्थाद्विरमन्ति धीराः॥”
रत्नैर्महाब्धेस्तुतुषुर्न देवा न भेजिरे भीमविषेण भीतिम्।

सुधां विना न प्रययुर्विरामं न निश्चितार्थाद्विरमन्ति धीराः॥ https://t.co/4NV2LXr8De — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 1, 2026
